basic_details.short_information: Chhattisgarh State Power Transmission Company Limited (CSPTCL) has released the Chhattisgarh State Power Companies Recruitment 2026 notification for 1,501 vacancies across CSPTCL, CSPDCL and CSPGCL. The recruitment includes Assistant Engineer, Junior Engineer, Data Entry Operator, Accounts Officer, Medical Officer, Attendant, Stenographer and various other Class II, III and IV posts.

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The official Chhattisgarh State Power Companies recruitment notification, issued on 5 November 2026, contains the detailed post-wise vacancy breakup, educational qualifications, age limits, application fees, pay matrices, selection procedures and other service conditions. Official Notification PDF: Chhattisgarh State Power Companies Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application window is open from 6 November to 26 November 2026. Candidates must complete registration and fee payment within the specified time.

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Overall Vacancies: 1,501 (195 Class II posts and 1,306 Class III/IV posts). Candidates should check the official notification for complete UR, SC, ST, OBC, female, ex-servicemen and other reservation details.

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age will be calculated as on 1 January 2026 . The minimum age is 18 or 21 years depending on the post, while maximum age limits vary according to post, domicile and category. For eligible Class II posts, the upper age limit for candidates without Chhattisgarh domicile is 30 years. Most Class III and IV posts are restricted to Chhattisgarh domicile candidates. Other conditions and relaxation provisions are specified in the notification. The overall maximum age after applicable relaxation is generally capped at 45 years.

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment process includes an online Computer-Based Test (CBT). Depending on the post, shortlisted candidates may also have to undergo an interview, physical examination, shorthand test, typing test or document verification. The online CBT will consist of 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks , with a duration of two hours. The examination carries negative marking of 0.25 marks for every incorrect answer. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% for UR/OBC candidates and 30% for SC/ST candidates. The question paper will be available in English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: CSPTCL Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates should carefully review the following requirements before submitting an application. Only Chhattisgarh domicile candidates are eligible for the notified Class III and IV posts. For Assistant Engineer or Junior Engineer, candidates may choose only one eligible engineering branch as prescribed. Applicants for posts common to all three power companies must provide their company preferences. Selection and company allocation will depend on merit, preferences and vacancy availability. Selected candidates must fulfil the prescribed medical fitness and document verification requirements. Selected candidates are required to execute the applicable service bond for a minimum four-year service period, including probation and training. As stated in the notification, the security deposit is refundable after completion of the agreement period, subject to the applicable conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in CSPTCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification's Class II, III and IV vacancy tables contain a total of 1,501 posts across CSPTCL, CSPDCL and CSPGCL.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSPTCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 26 November 2026 at 11:55 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualifications are required for CSPTCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post and include Class 10 with ITI, Engineering Diploma, Engineering Degree, Graduation and other prescribed professional qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSPTCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 or 21 years depending on the post. Maximum age limits vary by post, domicile and category, calculated as on 1 January 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for CSPTCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum basic pay ranges from Rs. 14,800 to Rs. 56,100, depending on the post and pay matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection includes an online CBT and applicable additional stages such as interviews, physical examinations, shorthand tests, typing tests and document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the CSPTCL CBT?
faq.answer: Yes. Each incorrect answer carries a deduction of 0.25 marks.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: Eligible non-Chhattisgarh candidates may apply for certain Class II posts, subject to the notification. Class III and IV posts require Chhattisgarh domicile.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee ranges from Rs. 200 to Rs. 800 depending on the post group and category. Eligible departmental candidates are exempted.
